import os
import subprocess
import sys

STATS = r'''import json
import sys


def count(path):
    with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        text = f.read()
    return len(text.splitlines()), len(text.split()), len(text)


def main(argv):
    as_json = "--json" in argv
    files = [a for a in argv[1:] if not a.startswith("--")]
    if not files:
        print("用法: stats.py [--json] <文件>", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2
    path = files[0]
    try:
        lines, words, chars = count(path)
    except OSError as e:
        print(f"错误: 无法读取文件 {path}: {e}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    if as_json:
        print(json.dumps({"lines": lines, "words": words, "chars": chars}, separators=(",", ":")))
    else:
        print(f"行数: {lines}")
        print(f"词数: {words}")
        print(f"字符数: {chars}")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main(sys.argv))
'''

with open("stats.py", "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as f:
    f.write(STATS)

sample = "hello world\nfoo bar baz\n\u4f60\u597d \u4e16\u754c\n"
with open("sample.txt", "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as f:
    f.write(sample)

env = dict(os.environ, PYTHONIOENCODING="utf-8")


def run(args):
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable] + args, capture_output=True, env=env)
    return p.returncode, p.stdout.decode("utf-8", "replace"), p.stderr.decode("utf-8", "replace")


exp_lines = len(sample.splitlines())
exp_words = len(sample.split())
exp_chars = len(sample)

rc1, out1, err1 = run(["stats.py", "sample.txt"])
rc2, out2, err2 = run(["stats.py", "--json", "sample.txt"])
rc3, out3, err3 = run(["stats.py", "no_such_file.txt"])

want1 = f"\u884c\u6570: {exp_lines}\n\u8bcd\u6570: {exp_words}\n\u5b57\u7b26\u6570: {exp_chars}\n"
want2 = '{"lines":%d,"words":%d,"chars":%d}\n' % (exp_lines, exp_words, exp_chars)

ok = (rc1 == 0 and out1 == want1 and rc2 == 0 and out2 == want2 and rc3 != 0
      and out3 == "" and err3.strip() != "")

print("--- stats.py: default output (exit %d) ---" % rc1)
sys.stdout.write(out1)
print("--- stats.py --json output (exit %d) ---" % rc2)
sys.stdout.write(out2)
print("--- missing file (exit %d) ---" % rc3)
sys.stdout.write(err3)
print("--- expected default / json ---")
sys.stdout.write(want1)
sys.stdout.write(want2)
print("checks: default=%s json=%s missing_file_nonzero_error=%s" % (
    out1 == want1, out2 == want2, rc3 != 0 and err3.strip() != ""))

if ok:
    print("DONE: stats.py written and verified (default + --json + missing-file error)")
else:
    print("FAIL: verification mismatch")
    sys.exit(1)
